# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- **Titles:** Master  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P58](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0058)</sub>; Mr. Phillips  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache that he frequently curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He exhibits spasmodic fits of reform and can carry matters with a high hand and sarcastically. He is known for giving way to a sarcastic and severe disposition, often neglecting younger pupils to focus on advanced students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Strict and corporal-punishment prone  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Preparing advanced pupils for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Courting Prissy Andrews  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school. During his tenure, he openly favored sixteen-year-old Prissy Andrews, spending much of his class time seated with her to explain lessons or write verses to her. When Anne Shirley dropped a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head after Gilbert called her "carrots," Mr. Phillips made Anne stand on the platform in front of the blackboard and wrote a note above her head about controlling her temper. The next day, after a group of tardy pupils returned late from gum-picking, Mr. Phillips selected Anne as a scapegoat and forced her to sit beside Gilbert Blythe as punishment. Later in the term, he promoted Anne and Gilbert into the fifth class to study advanced branches, praising Anne's rapid progress to Matthew Cuthbert despite her struggles in geometry. At the end of June, his term as teacher concluded and he gave an emotional farewell speech to the students before leaving Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Obtained the schoolmaster position in Avonlea because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
